YTA.Detect.List: Playlist link detected - every video will be imported into its own Foundry playlist.
YTA.Detect.Both: Video inside a playlist: choose a single sound or the whole playlist.
YTA.EmptyPlaylist: No importable videos in this playlist.
YTA.Title: Import audio from YouTube
YTA.NoHelperBody: Downloading needs the small YouTube Audio Helper on this computer. Download helper.exe, run it (keep its window open), then try again. The first run fetches yt-dlp and ffmpeg automatically.
YTA.Set.HelperHint: Address of the local yt-dlp helper (helper.exe).
YTA.Set.FolderHint: Folder inside Data (e.g. assets/youtube). Created automatically; also changeable in the import window.
YTA.Set.AddToPlaylist: Add to a playlist after import
YTA.Set.AddHint: Creates/uses a playlist named YouTube and adds the track.
YTA.OutdatedBody: This module needs YouTube Audio Helper {need} or newer. Close the running helper window, download the new foundry-yt-helper exe and run it.
YTA.Truncated: This playlist has more than 300 videos; only the first 300 are imported.
